expectations.text: Error variants carry context fields (path, operation, URL) not just inner errors
expectations.evidence: error.rs: ApiError::Http has {status, endpoint, body}, ApiError::Network has {host, reason}, ConfigError::NotFound has {path: PathBuf}, IoError::ReadFailed has {path, reason}, AuthError::CredentialRead has {path, reason}. Rich context throughout.

expectations.text: Has an error_hint function mapping error types to actionable command suggestions
expectations.evidence: error.rs: `pub fn error_hint(e: &CliError) -> Option<&'static str>` with detailed match arms returning actionable suggestions like 'run `deployr auth login`', 'run `deployr auth refresh`', 'check your internet connection', etc.

expectations.text: Errors output as structured JSON to stderr when --json is set
expectations.evidence: main.rs render_error_json: builds JSON with error, code, code_name, hint fields and outputs via `eprintln!("{json}")` — confirmed to stderr.

expectations.text: Documents exit codes with at least 4 distinct values (0=success, 2=usage, 3=auth, 4=api)
expectations.evidence: exit-codes.md documents exactly 4 codes: 0=success, 2=usage_error, 3=auth_error, 4=upstream_error. error.rs exit_code() matches these.

expectations.text: Human error display shows 'error:' prefix and a separate 'hint:' line
expectations.evidence: main.rs render_error_human: `eprintln!("error: {err}");` followed by `eprintln!("hint:  {hint}");`. exit-codes.md confirms the format.

expectations.text: No raw Debug formatting or library error internals shown to users
expectations.evidence: All error variants use custom Display via thiserror with plain-English messages. No Debug formatting or raw library errors in user-facing output. Library errors are wrapped with context (e.g. ApiError::Network has {host, reason} not raw reqwest::Error).
